row:
Alegre Equine Rescue is a Thoroughbred reschooling and adoption program based in Puerto Rico. Our mission is to give retired racehorses new careers as jumpers, dressage horses, and trail partners.

Follow along as we retrain OTTBs, share their stories, and help them find loving homes.

Learn more or support the rescue:
www.alegreequinerescue.com
